title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations in MidCity District, a University Drive NW corridor destination west of UAH.

cards.title: The Orion Amphitheater
cards.subtitle: MidCity District off University Drive NW
cards.notes: Check the official calendar before heading out; The Orion is a named 8,000-seat concert and community-event venue in the MidCity corridor.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled live-music and community-event venue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Orion’s official site describes it as an 8,000-seat venue and lists community events.
cards.access_notes: Events and ticket requirements vary; review the event listing before visiting.

cards.title: Topgolf Huntsville
cards.subtitle: Topgolf Drive NW, off University Drive NW
cards.notes: Reserve or check bay availability before going; this named MidCity destination offers Toptracer games in all-weather hitting bays.
cards.evidence_claim: Topgolf’s Huntsville page lists Toptracer games and more than 70 all-weather bays at 6100 Topgolf Drive NW.
cards.access_notes: Anyone under 16 must be supervised by a guest age 21 or older; bays require payment.
